summary: Safer rollbacks and a stricter check before a new SMTP sender is used.

fixes.title: Rollbacks stay until the next update
fixes.text: After a rollback, PIM Manager keeps serving the version you rolled back to until the next update, instead of switching back on its own.

fixes.title: Clearer SMTP sender test
fixes.text: A new SMTP sender is used only after a test sent over SMTP passes. If the test fails, the reason is now shown.
